text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap and I decide to spend our day
off by
going out for some fun. On our
way back, we spot
a familiar face.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello there. Back from an excursion,
I
presume? I take it that you've enjoyed
your day
off.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Are you on your way to training,
Rudolf?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Training" might be an overstatement. It
would be
more accurate to say I'm off to
clear my head.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I do make sure to savor my
days off.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it's just my nature, but whenever
I find
myself with free time, I'm somehow
overcome with
the urge to run.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I get what you mean. My thoughts
also
wander toward racing whenever I
have spare
time...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Well, either that or food.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Anyway... Training, huh?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Would that be okay? ...I'll go get
changed then.
Just give me one moment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The pair line up side by side, each set on

demonstrating their fearsome running
prowess.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They sprint forward, their postures
identical. Each
runner playfully fights for
the lead, taking it and
losing it in turns.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Huff... I must say... running with somebody else is... always a rewarding experience.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I agree.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I agree.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Maybe so. But the way you run is

outstanding, Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That's why I study your race footage.
Your
remarkable extensions, the way
you dig into the
track...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hah! Receiving a compliment like that
from you
makes me feel strangely
self-conscious.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Still, regardless of effort, someone's
running style
isn't something you can
simply emulate.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There must be something inherently
similar about
the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Something similar? Like how we're
around the
same height?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That's not quite what I was talking
about...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like racing with Symboli Rudolf
has been
a constructive experience for
Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha... It isn't like we were competing in
earnest .

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah... The goal here wasn't to win...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That said, the notion of a genuine
contest does
sound agreeable.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
What do you say? How does a
scrimmage strike
you?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That... would be an honor. You've shown
me so
much kindness I can barely keep
track!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Pffft... Barely keep track... Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You're quite droll, Oguri Cap!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Barely keep track... Hehe! I do
apologize...
Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Um, I don't really follow, but... if you're
happy,
then I'm happy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, they have the race as
planned.
Oguri Cap, scrimmaging in
front of a full crowd of
spectators, seems
to be improving with every
passing
moment.
